description: Retrospective Application for the Change of Use of the Second Floor Flat from dentist surgery to residential flat
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-ae315c36-7fff-19aa-969c-88c89d6fb6b9"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed development, by reason of lack of provision of affordable housing, would fail to adequately contribute towards the provision of mixed and balanced communities and housing need in the local area. As such, the development would not be consistent with Policies H4 and H5 of the London Plan (2021), Hackney Local Plan Policies LP12, LP13 and NPPF (2024) paragraph 64 and the Hackney S106 Planning Contributions Supplementary Planning Document (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-a38ab979-7fff-60d5-6f4d-efaca667d6ee"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed development, by reason of a lack of sufficient energy efficiency measures and/or financial contribution towards carbon offsetting, would fail to achieve the maximum feasible reductions in carbon dioxide emissions, contrary to Hackney Local Plan (LP33) Policy LP55 and London Plan (2021) Policy SI2.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-f3999b05-7fff-b03f-2b79-f44a1db819a3"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">In the absence of a suitable undertaking to secure that the occupiers of the residential unit would not be able to apply for on street parking permit, the proposals would have an adverse impact on street parking conditions, highway safety and sustainable modes of transport, contrary to Policies T1 and T4 of the London Plan (2021) and Hackney Local Plan Policies LP43 and LP45.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-9905e479-7fff-123f-c594-a218d9376ffb"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">In the absence of information relating to refuse storage and collection, the proposal fails to meet the requirements for refuse collection and would be contrary to Policy LP57 of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020).</span></span></p>
